label: Paper summary checkpoint
description: Maintain durable, reusable, source-versioned paper evidence outside run cleanup and separate from user notes. Append cited evidence after each batch; the write is verified before raw text may be discarded. Repeating an identical append is idempotent. Records retain exact read spans and model/prompt provenance. Extraction/source changes invalidate reuse. Read existing evidence on resumption; follow resume_action, resume_start and resume_offset. A final append returns final_checkpoint only when it fits the output budget, otherwise read bounded slices. Complete is true only for contiguous full coverage.

parameter_descriptions.document_id: The exact local document ID being summarized.
parameter_descriptions.action: Use append after each paper-read batch, or read to retrieve a bounded checkpoint slice.
parameter_descriptions.content: For append, provide compact new evidence (usually 100-300 words, more only for dense findings): claims, mechanisms, exact results and conditions, citations, limitations, unresolved questions and unread coverage. Do not copy raw text. Use null for read.
parameter_descriptions.offset: For read, the zero-based character offset. Start at 0 and follow next_offset. Use null for append.
parameter_descriptions.limit: For read, at most 8000 characters. Use null for append.
